newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Friday, as prices are expected to consolidate sharp gains made during the previous session, traders said.

A late, speculative-led buying spree on Thursday fueled the benchmark July contract to 11.50 cents, its highest level since reaching 11.54 cents on June 6. October hit a lifetime high of 11.35 cents, before easing slightly by the close.

The July contract settled 0.23 cent firmer at 11.49 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.24 to 11.50 cents. October ended up 0.19 cent at 11.34 cents, while the back months finished 0.14 and 0.13 higher.
An estimated 31,016 lots changed hands on the day.
Trading sources expect the speculators to begin liquidating a heavy net long position after options expire today.
As of early Wednesday, open interest in July stood at 72,995 lots, down 2,257 lots.

LIFFE white sugar futures were trading mixed on Friday, with prices confined to a tight range. At 0900 EDT/1300, spot August stood $0.30 firmer at $324.00, while the back months were trading $0.20 higher to $0.30 lower.
